text: You are working on a group project. One team member, Rahul, hasn't done any work for two weeks and is making excuses. The deadline is tomorrow. What is your immediate reaction?

options.text: Calmly talk to him to understand the issue, then divide his work among the group so we finish on time.
Get furious, yell at him in the group chat, and report him to the professor immediately.
Ignore it. If we fail, we fail. Too much hassle to deal with it now.

text: You have a free Saturday and 1000 rupees. How would you prefer to spend it?

options.text: Buying a book or attending a workshop to learn something new.
Going out for a movie and expensive dinner with friends.
Ordering junk food and sleeping/binge-watching TV at home.

text: Your internet connection stops working right before you need to submit an assignment. What do you do?

options.text: Calmly use your phone hotspot or go to a neighbor's house to submit it.
Panic, scream at the ISP customer care, and throw the router.
Give up and go to sleep, hoping the professor accepts a late submission.
